name: door-takes-what-names-nothing
breaks: the submission door refuses an update that does not name what stands for the app
red: refuses a sale naming no manifest, naming the one it must
refuses a sale naming another manifest, naming the one it must

name: content-update-taken-while-a-sale-waits

red: takes the sale naming the standing manifest, and refuses the owner's content update while it waits for payment
